'''DT-F16''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|female]] [[death trooper]] [[Stormtrooper Commander|commander]] who, along with [[DT-F16's squad|her]] [[squad]], were tasked with guarding a large [[kyber crystal]] from the [[Jedha system]] for delivery to the [[Tonnis sector]] in [[Freighter 2716]] to rendezvous with an [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]] helmed by [[Captain]] [[Slavin]]. At a brief stop at [[Faos Station]], the freighter was infiltrated by the rebels [[Saw Gerrera]], [[Ezra Bridger]], [[Sabine Wren]], and [[C1-10P|Chopper]]. DT-F16 attempted to combat the rebels, but was [[Death|killed]] when Saw rigged the kyber crystal up to the freighter's [[hyperdrive]], creating a bomb, and Ezra, Sabine, Chopper, and the freighter's prisoners escaped in a [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle|''Lambda''-class shuttle]] intended for the commander.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Captain, rebels led by Saw Gerrera have breached hold six and taken possession of the cargo. Alert Director Krennic and Imperial Command.|DT-F16|<ref name="INR" />}}
[[File:DT-F16_INR.png|thumb|left|250px|DT-F16 commanded a squad of death troopers.]]
At some point, DT-F16 sprinted down an [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] hallway whilst firing her [[E-11D blaster carbine]].<ref name="Imperial Death Troopers Unit Expansion">{{Legion|set=Imperial Death Troopers Unit Expansion}}</ref>

In [[1 BBY]],<ref name="Chronology Note" /> DT-F16 and her [[DT-F16's squad|squad]] were traveling on [[Freighter 2716]], a covert Imperial [[Starship|ship]] disguised as a civilian vessel, guarding a large [[kyber crystal]] that was being delivered to a rendezvous in the [[Tonnis sector]]. Unbeknownst to most of the freighter's crew, it was [[Mission to Faos Station|infiltrated]] by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|rebels]] [[Saw Gerrera]], [[Ezra Bridger]], [[Sabine Wren]] and [[C1-10P|Chopper]] during a stop at [[Faos Station]]. When the rebels discovered the hold with the kyber [[crystal]], she encountered the rebels, and ordered her [[death trooper]]s to open [[fire]]. As the [[trooper]]s quickly fell to the rebels in the smoke generated by several [[Smoke grenade|smoke bombs]] tossed by Wren, DT-F16 ordered the remaining troopers to group up. During the skirmish, one of Gerrera's [[blaster]] [[Laser|shots]] struck the [[Carbon-freezing|carbon-frozen]] crystal, prompting her to order a retreat; however, she would be the only one to escape, as her remaining troopers were blasted by Gerrera and Wren.<ref name="INR" />

DT-F16 later informed the freighter's [[captain]], [[Wells]], that rebels led by Gerrera infiltrated the hold and requested reinforcements. The captain gave her reinforcements, warning her that she had to retake the crystal, something which she was aware of as they would be punished, likely through [[Death|fatal]] means, if the crystal was stolen. When reinforcements arrived (in the form of four [[stormtrooper]]s), she returned to the hold, only to find both the rebels and the crystal gone. The captain informed her that they had lost contact with the [[engine]] room, so she made her way there.<ref name="INR" />

[[File:DT-F16_down_INR.png|thumb|right|250px|DT-F16 is taken down by Ezra Bridger]]
Upon arriving, Gerrera, who had turned the crystal into a ticking [[time]] bomb, fled the area after freeing Bridger and Wren. DT-F16 and the stormtroopers prepared to fire, but before they could do so, the crystal electrocuted the two troopers in front of her. She realized that she had to leave immediately and ordered the remaining troopers to abandon ship. She made her way to hold 12, where a [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle|''Lambda''-class shuttle]] was waiting for her departure. By the time she got there, the freighter's [[prisoner]]s, who had been freed by the rebels, were boarding. She and the two troopers accompanying her attempted to open fire, but Bridger and Wren, who had also arrived, managed to overpower her and the two troopers before getting on the shuttle and taking off. Refusing to give up DT-F16 made a futile attempt to destroy the [[shuttle]] with her blaster, and was subsequently killed in the ensuing explosion.<ref name="INR" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Send all security personnel to meet me at hold six. In the meantime, purge the escape pods. No one leaves this vessel.|DT-F16|<ref name="INR" />}}
DT-F16 was a female death trooper who had a mechanical voice that was caused by her [[helmet]]. DT-F16 was determined to ensure the safe delivery of a large kyber crystal to Slavin's Star Destroyer and feared the consequences of failure.<ref name="INR" /> DT-F16 suffered no fool and demanded the best from her [[troop]]s.<ref name="Databank" />

==Skills and abilities==
As a Death trooper squad commander, DT-F16 led her squad with strength and the ability to know when to fight versus when her forces should retreat.<ref name="Databank" /> However, despite her leadership skills, she failed to apprehend the rebel infiltrators and stop them from destroying the kyber crystal and escaping with the prisoners.<ref name="INR" />

==Equipment==
DT-F16 wore [[death trooper armor]] featuring a [[Neuro-Saav Corp.|Neuro-Saav]] macromotion monitor on her helmet, an [[IM-40 three-slot ammunition and tool pouch|IM-40 three slot ammunition and tool pouch]] and a black shoulder [[pauldron]], and had a green-tinted visor. Assumedly, she had a [[Speech scrambler|voice scrambler]] installed in her helmet, despite her and her squad not using theirs, and underwent the same augmentations as other death troopers.<ref name="Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide">''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]''</ref> The commander wielded an E-11D [[blaster]],<ref name="INR" /> the standard blaster of death troopers.<ref name="DoR">''[[Dawn of Rebellion]]''</ref> She also used [[C-25 fragmentation grenade|C-25 fragmentation grenades]].<ref name="INR" /> 

==Behind the scenes==
DT-F16 first appeared in "[[In the Name of the Rebellion]]," a two-part episode of the [[Star Wars Rebels Season Four|fourth season]] of ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]''. She was voiced by [[Jennifer Hale]],<ref name="INR" /> who voiced [[Aayla Secura]], [[Riyo Chuchi]], [[Lolo Purs]], and [[Trella Bare'Ah]] in ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''.
